note: Frames extracted headless with yt-dlp + ffmpeg from public YouTube videos. Credit the channel when shown. Most source streams are 480p, so frames are 854x480. The crackdown notice is from a 1080p stream scaled to 1280 wide.

shots.caption: Stronghold Takeover hex map early in a busy war. Three organizations' territory shows as pink, cyan and purple, with attack lines running from their Initial Strongholds. The streamer webcam covers the bottom-right corner.

Map view with the Team Status panel (3 teams, Team 1 attacking). Flag icons give the number of queued attackers and their countdown timers. Green lines are your own org's attack routes. Two hospital special tiles sit at the right edge.

Centre of the map: the 1250-point top-tier stronghold, ringed by blocked (no-entry) tiles, with 150/75-point strongholds nearby. Team 3 has dropped to 561,028 CP after losing members, and its status is Idle.

Stronghold (28,72) info panel: Garrisoned Troops 2/10 with two stacked player defense teams (1.37M and 1.57M CP), and the banner 'Defenders of the Stronghold successfully resisted the attack'. The Withdraw Team and Reinforce Team buttons are visible.

Battle Status: only 2 characters are left on the defense team (dead defenders do not come back between fights) against a full 1,566,311 CP attack team. The log reads 'defeated ... and successfully pierced the Defense' and '... sent Team to Garrison'.

Team Status mid-war: Teams 2 and 3 show 'Reviving...', each with a Quick Resurrection button (paid with diamonds or potions, and the cost climbs). The attack-attempt counter (0/11) and the stronghold-point total are at the top and bottom.
Ranking List near the end of the war: Forced 2 Pay 12,663 pts (12 strongholds held), BR0THERH00D 8,149, Phantom 3,820. Rank rewards are shown on the right.

Lv.3 Stronghold 001 Battle Status: Defenders Left 6,454, with fixed 1,100,000 CP NPC defenders facing the streamer's 1,652,740 CP Anteiku team. The kill feed reads 'defeated 81 / 13 / 52 teams of defenders in a row'. Org point ranking is on the left.

Official 'Continued Crackdown on Violations and Recent Penalties' notice. Illegally obtained resources are deducted and upgrades rolled back, listed accounts get permanent bans or 30-day suspensions, and this batch is disqualified from the season's Global Stronghold War.
